biggest_catch: The friend's account must stay open at least 90 days before your $100 is paid - and the referral card must be presented at account opening, not later.
catches: Referrer earns $100 for every referred member who opens a new share savings account and keeps it open for at least 90 days.
No limitations on the number of referrals.
Referred members must open a new PFCU share account as the primary owner and can't have any existing or prior PFCU account.
Referral card must be presented at account opening with the current member's name, address, and phone number.
Promotion ends December 31st of the current year (2026).
Cannot be combined with other offers.
A 1099 may be issued for the value of the gift.
Membership: 13 South Florida counties + employees of FPL/NextEra, Ryder System, Bonefish & Tarpon Trust, and immediate family of members.

steps: Complete the online referral form or print it to submit in person.
Friend presents the referral card (with your name, address, phone number) when opening a new PFCU share account.
Friend keeps the account open for at least 90 days.
timing: $100 paid after the new account has been open at least 90 days.
when_cash_arrives: Per official terms: $100 paid after the new account has been open at least 90 days. — structural: a 90-day account-open/seasoning requirement must elapse before payout.
maximize: Front-load the friend's qualifying activity: terms give the friend a multi-week window, but the payout clock starts at completion — a friend who finishes in week 1 gets you paid weeks earlier.
The 90-day seasoning/hold is structural — pick a different referral program if you need money sooner.
